errorCodes.meaning: The network opens no room with id `room`.

The evidence does not admit the requester: the membership credential does not verify, does not name the requester's identity, or is revoked, suspended or of indeterminate status; or the chain does not end at a group registered here for the room's role by a member whose entry is `acknowledged`. `details.message` says which.

A chain link does not verify — a proof fails, the acceptance is not a groupRegistered credential from the registration's recipient or its digest does not match the registration, the acceptance is revoked or suspended or its status cannot be determined, the link is out of order, or the chain is longer than the network follows. `details.index` names the link and `details.message` says why.

ChainLink.description: One registration on the path from a person's community up to the network a room belongs to: the member's signed request and the accepting network's groupRegistered credential.

acceptance.description: The network's groupRegistered credential: a statement (`https://openvtc.org/vtn/vsc/groupRegistered/1`) issued by the accepting network, subject the group, `object.digestMultibase` the digest of `registration`, with a `credentialStatus` on the network's revocation list.

Credential.description: A DTG credential (W3C VC 2.0, JSON) exactly as signed. Verified by the party relying on it, never by its shape here: it is an open object so a binding cannot narrow away a member the proof covers.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Membership.description: A person's membership credential (VMC) from a community that is a member of this network, holder-bound to the requester's identity. Open for the same reason as `Credential`.

RoleName.description: A role's name: 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`.

passMinutes.description: How long a pass lasts, in minutes: at most 1440 (24 hours). A pass is short-lived because it is not revoked; eligibility is re-proved for the next one.

role.description: The role whose groups' members may enter.

pass.description: The pass: a credential the network signs for the person, valid for `passMinutes`.

via.description: The networks the person's eligibility ran through, from the one nearest their community up to this network.

SignedTask.description: A complete Trust Task document, with its proof, exactly as signed and received. Verified as a document in its own right; open so its proof still covers every member, and so its digest can be recomputed.

schema.description: A person's request for a room pass, with the evidence that they are eligible. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

chain.description: The registrations from the person's group up to a group registered with this network, nearest first. Empty when the group is registered here directly.

membership.description: The person's membership credential from their group, naming the requester's identity.
